Accounting Time Tracker

A timekeeping tool for the accounting building, with an approval workflow and an audit trail, rebuilt after IT review.

Problem

The accounting building needed a timekeeping tool with an approval step and an audit trail behind every entry.

What I did

I designed and built it as an Azure Function, with an approval workflow and a full audit trail.

It was piloted first, then rebuilt after IT review, and the rebuilt version is the one in production. A tool the accounting team depends on should meet the same bar as any system IT supports.

How it works

Every entry is logged before it can be approved, so the approval is always of something with a trail behind it.

Results

As stated on the résumé.

After a pilot and a rebuild for IT review
In production

What I'd do next

Use the approved hours to rank which close tasks to automate next, so the automation queue is ordered by measured time rather than by guesswork.
